# We Care Physiotherapy & Sports & Chiropractic Clinic — Guntur

> Advanced physiotherapy, chiropractic, and rehabilitation clinic in Kothapeta, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh. Specializes in dry needling, myofascial release, cupping therapy, sports rehab, paralysis treatment, and post-surgery recovery — following international rehab protocols.
